title: Adifase
description:
I built and ran Adifase, a live voting platform used for a real election. Voters cast their ballots through a simple web interface, with the frontend on Vercel, the API on Render and the data in Supabase Postgres.

Running it live meant solving production problems as they appeared. Mid-election I traced a rate-limiting fault on Render's proxy, where a missing Express trust-proxy setting made every voter share one limit bucket, and fixed it without losing votes.
legacy: Live voting system built on Vercel, Render and Supabase.

title: Dibia
description:
Dibia is a multi-tenant platform where pharmacy businesses register and run their operation under one system, each in its own workspace. It is designed around real pharmacy work: inventory with batch and expiry tracking, purchasing, suppliers, point of sale, staff roles and branch management.

It works offline first. Data is stored in IndexedDB and syncs when the connection returns, and a status indicator always shows whether the user is online or offline.
legacy: Multi-tenant platform where pharmacy businesses register and run their store, offline-first with sync.

title: Medical Clerking System
description:
A clinical record-keeping system for taking patient histories. The React and Vite frontend runs on Vercel, and a Node, Express and Prisma backend with PostgreSQL runs on Render.

Questions are generated adaptively through an AI model, so the history follows the patient's answers instead of a fixed form. The interface is styled after a paper clerking sheet to feel familiar to clinicians.
legacy: Backend and frontend for clinical record-keeping, built on Render Postgres and Prisma.

title: KAIROS
description:
KAIROS is an AI voice assistant built around a personality rather than a list of commands. It handles natural-language reminders with spoken and on-screen alerts, a live HUD, memory of how you like to talk, file reading, weather and multi-language replies.

The Flask backend routes each request to the best available AI provider by intent and falls back automatically when one fails. Supabase stores the data and Paystack handles billing, with an early-access community already testing it.
tech: Flask, Three.js, Supabase, Paystack, Voice AI
legacy: Reminders, a live HUD, personality memory and multi-language support.

title: SnapCode
description:
SnapCode turns a screenshot into working front-end code. Users drag and drop an image, a vision model reads the layout, and the app returns code they can use straight away.

It is a complete SaaS: a FastAPI backend with JWT authentication and SQLAlchemy models, AI generation through OpenRouter, and Stripe subscriptions for paid plans.
legacy: Screenshot-to-code SaaS with a FastAPI backend, Stripe billing and AI generation.

title: MyGuestly AI
description:
An event hosting platform where hosts create events, manage guest lists and check guests in by scanning QR codes. The React frontend talks to a Node, Express, Prisma and PostgreSQL backend deployed on Render.

I built it for a hackathon, wiring every page to the live API: authentication with silent token refresh, events, guests, QR check-in and profiles. Most of the final stretch went into fixing real integration bugs across CORS, cookies and routing.
legacy: Event management platform with a React frontend and a live backend, built for a hackathon.

title: AttendX
description:
A web-based attendance system built for Koforidua Technical University in Ghana. Students can only mark attendance when they are inside a GPS geofence of about 150 metres around the venue, and only during time windows that lecturers or admins control.

Device fingerprinting adds a further check. The stack is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript on the front, Node and Express behind it, and Supabase Postgres for data.
legacy: GPS-geofenced attendance system built for a university client in Ghana.

title: MyChatify
description:
A real-time chat app with direct messages, groups and broadcast channels, voice notes, WebRTC audio and video calls, reactions, disappearing messages, 24-hour stories and a full admin panel for moderation.

I rebuilt it for NGO and community use after WhatsApp banned a set of groups, with a focus on privacy, verified emails and push notifications. It runs on Vite and React, Express with Socket.io, MongoDB and Cloudinary.
legacy: Chat app rebuilt for NGO/production use after a client's WhatsApp groups got banned.

title: FireZone
description:
A community hub for Free Fire and Garena players, launched with a waitlist page so squads could sign up early. Signups go through EmailJS and there is a one-tap WhatsApp channel button.

To get around GitHub's file size limit I replaced background video files with an animated CSS background. I built the page twice, once in React with Tailwind and once in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and deployed it on Netlify.
legacy: Community platform for Free Fire / Garena players.

title: Cookie Naturals
description:
A skincare e-commerce storefront with its own backend, written in vanilla JavaScript. Customers get a shop page and accounts, while the owner gets an admin dashboard to manage the store.

Authentication uses role-based routing, so shoppers and admins land in the right place. The backend is Node with Sequelize on a hosted database.
legacy: Skincare e-commerce storefront and backend, built in vanilla JavaScript.

title: BLVCK MUSIC NATION
description:
A website for a music promotion agency based in Aba, Nigeria. It presents the agency's services and artists in a bold, dark layout that works well on phones.

I added full SEO and GEO meta tags, JSON-LD structured data and a clean SVG icon set, so the agency is easier to find on search engines and in AI answers.
legacy: Site for a music promotion agency based in Aba, Nigeria.

title: VoidStack Academy
description:
VoidStack Academy is my own web development and ethical-hacking bootcamp. I teach full-stack skills in small groups and one-to-one sessions on a weekly schedule.

I built its waitlist site with EmailJS signup, a light and dark mode, animation and an all-SVG icon set, plus a student portal for attendance, assignments, quizzes, a leaderboard and announcements.
legacy: My own coding & ethical-hacking bootcamp — plus the student portal I built for it.
